company.name: Power Finance Corporation Limited
company.tag: Lends money to companies that build power plants, run electricity networks and develop other infrastructure.
company.productNote: Selected examples of work the company finances. The pictures illustrate what funding helps pay for; they do not show equipment manufactured or operated by this lender.

offerings.name: Conventional power plant loans
offerings.category: Lends to power stations that generate electricity using fuels such as coal or gas.
offerings.alt: An Indian thermal power station with two tall chimneys above the plant buildings; example photo, not a verified PFC-financed asset.

offerings.name: Solar project loans
offerings.category: Lends to build sites with rows of panels that turn sunlight into electricity.
offerings.alt: Rows of solar panels across the Bhadla solar site in Rajasthan; example photo, not a verified PFC-financed asset.

offerings.name: Wind project loans
offerings.category: Lends to wind projects, where tall turbines use wind to generate electricity.
offerings.alt: Tall wind turbines beside a field in Tamil Nadu; example photo, not a verified PFC-financed asset.

offerings.name: Hydropower loans
offerings.category: Finance projects that use moving water to generate electricity
offerings.alt: Water beside a dam — conceptual illustration; not a photograph

offerings.name: Transmission project loans
offerings.category: Lends for towers and lines that move electricity over long distances.
offerings.alt: A steel electricity tower in Maharashtra carrying high-voltage power lines; example photo, not a verified PFC-financed asset.

offerings.name: Distribution loans
offerings.category: Finance local electricity companies and network work
offerings.alt: Power lines supplying a home — conceptual illustration; not a photograph

offerings.name: Infrastructure and logistics loans
offerings.category: Fund eligible infrastructure and goods-movement projects beyond the power sector
offerings.alt: Freight containers and a truck — conceptual illustration; not a photograph
